newsitem.title: UK: Logica surges on outlook, acquisition pact.
newsitem.headline: Logica surges on outlook, acquisition pact.

text.p: Shares in Logica Plc surged on Thursday, after the UK software group said issued a positive profit forecast and said it planned to buy Aldiscon Ltd, dealers said.
AT 0750 GMT, the shares were up 52-1/2p to 742-1/2.
Logica said it expected its annual pre-tax profits to rise 14 percent to 28.1 million stg. It said its directors intended to recommend a final dividend of 5.8p.

Equally as bullish was the group's announcement that it would buy Aldiscon, which supplies network systems and services to the telecommunications industry, for a maximum of 51.0 million stg, dealers said.
"The outlook looks very good for Logica," said one market-maker.
Elsewhere in the sector, shares in Misys Plc climbed 52-1/2p to 1517-1/2, having set a record at 1525 earlier.
Misys shares resumed their advance after the computer systems sales group on Wednesday issued a bullish trading statement, dealers said.

The shares also were lifted by a Financial Times report that said Misys was to sell a range of 30 car insurance policies to the public bringing the company into competition with its customers who buy its quote-tracking databases.
